envelope.action_line: Site medical heads: read your own row first; all listed sites have enough audited notes.
caveats: The score is an encounter proxy, not a clinician scorecard.
Notes where PDQI-9 was not assessed score 0 on note quality, which raises the index, so full NQI is shown over assessed notes only.
OPD site is the doctor's home site (governance DB engagement), not where the note was written.
Domain scores are assumed to be on the same 0-100 scale as the NQI.

headline.plain: about 76 out of 100 on 85% of notes
headline.sentence: Mean OPD NQI (PDQI-assessed notes only) was 76 over 149 notes between 2026-09-26 to 2026-10-23, on 85% of notes.

envelope.precision_line: About 1 in 5 findings are wrong or contested (engine precision; the catalogue has no family-specific figure).
